name: kubiq-transport
description: Reference for the wire between Kubiq's two halves — the message contract in crates/kubiq-proto, the Hub and its routing, the socket framing, the ULID id types, the log sink, and the remote listener and dialer that put a UI on another machine. Use when adding, changing or removing a message, touching the bus or routing, wiring a remote host, changing the framing, adding an id type, or adding a log subsystem.
